title: urtica debilis
intro: Urtica debilis, commonly known as Japanese burnet, is a flowering plant species in the nettle family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral effects. The therapeutic actions of Urtica debilis include stimulating the immune system, reducing fever, and relieving pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
